description: Tests that prove Retrofit's safety and conformance rules (phase-7.md, Evidence analyzer). The analyzer rejects a candidate when any of these is missing, skipped or failed in its suite's report. suite: unit -> vitest-unit.json, perf -> vitest-perf.json, db -> vitest-db.json, playwright -> playwright.json. title: the vitest fullName, or the Playwright describe titles and test title joined by one space. file: repository-relative for vitest, relative to the Playwright testDir for Playwright.
